name: oh-my-herdr
description: OmO-style multi-agent orchestration on herdr: Claude Code leads, worker agents run in herdr panes. Also a compact status line.

band.title: Wave band
band.description: Show the current wave's progress bar above the prompt.

statusbar.title: Status line
statusbar.description: Turn the hint line under the prompt into one compact line: model, folder and git branch, context bar, 5-hour/weekly usage. Works in every session, not only in herdr.

wakeOnSettle.title: Wake the lead
wakeOnSettle.description: Submit a prompt to the lead when a wave settles or a worker needs it, so it never waits in a turn.

notifyHuman.title: herdr notifications
notifyHuman.description: Show a herdr notification (with sound) when a worker is blocked or a wave settles.

autoContinue.title: Auto-continue
autoContinue.description: When a turn ends with open tasks or gates and no worker busy, prompt the lead to keep going (Sisyphus mode).

autoContinueMax.title: Auto-continue limit
autoContinueMax.description: Most auto-continue prompts in a row; any prompt you type resets the count.
